answers.question: restaurant Gatukök: no opening hours
answers.answer: Still open. Jernhusen's shop list (Espresso House, Järnvägens café och restaurang, Järnvägens Take Away, Pressbyrån) has no 'Gatukök'; the closest match is Järnvägens Take Away, for which Jernhusen gives no hours and no website. OSM's separate node 'Takeaway Linköpings centralstation' carries hours but no owner/shop source confirms it or that it is the same as the 'Gatukök' node (n9081941517). The 'Gatukök' node may be outdated or a duplicate; check on site.

open: Gatukök (OSM n9081941517): no hours from any allowed source; possibly the same as Järnvägens Take Away or outdated.

Lifts: OSM maps no lift at Linköping C; no owner/Trafikverket text or plan found that says whether the tunnel has lifts to platforms 2–3 and 4–5 (the stairs there are tagged ramp=yes in OSM). Unconfirmed.
Tunnels and stairs are OSM only; no published plan of Linköping C was found (Jernhusen links only Google Maps and Östgötatrafiken's dynamic web map).
Signposted names of the tunnels: none found.
Positions of toilets, lockers, ATM and photo booth inside the building: not stated by Jernhusen.
Järnvägens Take Away and Pressbyrån hours: no shop/owner source.
